notes.title: The Nano Neighbors Demo is Out!🥳
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]
We’re excited to share that the [b]Nano Neighbors Demo is out![/b] After months and months of development and polishing, it’s time for you to check out what Nano Neighbors is all about. Download the demo, play, explore, hang out, and let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2v_hr417Yi0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Once you're in, you’ll meet your NANO. You can build and decorate its cozy pod, play mini-games to earn coins, get pets, and earn passive income to unlock more decorations. You can do all this solo or together with your friends. Let them know about the demo, and give it a crack together.
[/p][p]Once you give Nano Neighbors a shot, [b]we’d love to hear your feedback![/b] Nano Neighbors is being made for you, so it only makes sense to ask for your thoughts, ideas, and suggestions as we continue shaping it together over the coming months. [/p][p][/p][p]Share your feedback through the in-game survey or join us on [url="https://discord.gg/WPnBcqme4V"][u]our official Discord[/u][/url] and share your thoughts there. And if you feel like showing off your decorating skills, we've got the right channels for that on our Discord, too! We’d be thrilled to see the Nano homes you create.[/p][p][/p][p]So hop into the Nano universe, dive in and see what we’ve built, and help us make the game even better! We’re dying to see you play and hear what you think![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p][/p][p]Your friends at Studio BitDot[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590780/Nano_Neighbors/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: We have 10,000 Wishlists!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It’s been just under a month since we showcased Nano Neighbors during Women’s Lead Games, and since then, over 10,000 cool people like yourselves have Wishlisted our game on Steam! Thank you!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549251/0e69c1bb532191de690b1a83c03d968ebe4f3e2c.gif[/img]

For a small, four-person team like ours, this is such a huge achievement. To think that there are so many people who like what we’re making is seriously so motivating and inspiring. So thanks so much for your support - it means a lot to us, and more!

Right now, we are working hard on Nano Neighbors. We’ve added sooo much to the game! Soon we will have some news that we are dying to share with you all (demo perhaps?!?!). So stay with us a little bit longer, as we hope to get Nano Neighbors in your hands, and on your screens, sooner rather than later.

Once again, thanks to each one of you for the support and positive comments! And if you want to stay close to us, [url=https://discord.gg/xtadeb6A8P]join our Discord too[/url]!

Until next time!

Your friends at Studio BitDot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590780/Nano_Neighbors/

notes.title: Meet Your New Digital Best Friend – Nano Neighbors!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]
We’re beyond excited to officially show off our chill co-op desktop idle life sim, [i]Nano[/i] [i]Neighbors[/i]! Our game was just featured on the Women-Led Games Showcase, which is part of Summer Game Fest.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-mLEUjGd6VI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]No timers, no stress. Just good vibes, styles and decor, and a place to hang with your friends.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]In [i]Nano Neighbors[/i], you step into the near future and become a [b]Handler[/b] of customizable android companions called [b]NANOs[/b]. These digital beings live right on your desktop and are hanging out with you when you work, chill, or play on your PC.[/p][p][/p][p]Your NANO is an extension of you - you can style their look, help them complete jobs, decorate their tiny capsule home, have pets (even a panda), and you can invite other people’s NANOs over to hang out and chat all on the bottom of your screen! Just think cozy life sim meets futuristic desktop companion with some fun surprises in store and in between.[/p][p][/p][p]If you like what [i]Nano Neighbors[/i] is about, add it to your Steam Wishlist. And we would love to hear your thoughts and suggestions too, so join our [url="https://discord.gg/xtadeb6A8P"]Discord[/url] and share them with us. It’s also the place to be if you want to play our game before anyone else. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for tuning in and we’ll be sharing more [i]Nano Neighbors[/i] goodness with you soon![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Studio BitDot[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590780/Nano_Neighbors/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.gg/xtadeb6A8P" style="button"]Join our Discord[/url][/p]
